keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Simon Graves, PEC Zwolle. Telstar 1, PEC Zwolle 0.
Goal! Telstar 1, PEC Zwolle 1. Dylan Mbayo (PEC Zwolle) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Simon Graves.
Ibrahim Cissoko (PEC Zwolle) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Telstar 1, PEC Zwolle 2. Dylan Mbayo (PEC Zwolle) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sydney van Hooijdonk.
First Half ends, Telstar 1, PEC Zwolle 2.
Second Half begins Telstar 1, PEC Zwolle 2.
Goal! Telstar 1, PEC Zwolle 3. Ibrahim Cissoko (PEC Zwolle) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Telstar. Gerald Alders replaces Gabi Caschili.
Substitution, Telstar. Nökkvi Thórisson replaces Emirhan Demircan.
Substitution, Telstar. Jeff Hardeveld replaces Marvin Peersman.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Tijs Velthuis replaces Ibrahim Cissoko.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Olivier Aertssen replaces Dylan Mbayo.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Thijs Oosting replaces Jan Bürger.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Gabriel Reiziger replaces Younes Namli.
Substitution, Telstar. Rui Mendes replaces Isaiah Ahmed.
